selection: Predefined hand-written tasks, frozen before native evaluation; not independent external benchmark
scope: 12 domain, 12 first-use questions, disjoint token hash from P4/P6; correctness exploratory only
instruction: Answer the question briefly. Use only its stated premises. Provide no extra discussion.

items.question: If a nearby star has annual parallax of 0.1 arcseconds, what is its distance in parsecs?
Cross homozygous AA with homozygous aa. What genotype do all F1 offspring have?
What is the pH of a solution whose hydrogen ion concentration is 0.001 mol per liter at 25 C?
What is the decimal value of the binary number 101101?
A price rises by ten percent then falls by ten percent relative to the new price. What is its overall percentage change?
A constant 100 watt device operates for 3 hours. How much energy does it consume in kilowatt hours?
Which year did the Berlin Wall fall?
What is the English simple past tense of the irregular verb go?
A binary classifier has 30 true positives and 10 false positives. What is its precision?
Compute seven times eight minus nine.
By Newton's second law, what force in newtons is needed for a 2 kilogram mass to accelerate at 3 meters per second squared?
A differential drive robot has two wheels with equal radius, turning forward at the same angular speed. Does its ideal planar path curve or stay straight?
